name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands opening the door, so hard Existence(door_open) is required. The stated “then” makes Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard, while “if possible” makes picking up the box a soft goal. The soft goal does not make the door-opening existence redundant.

texts: The door must be open before the target box is picked up.
If possible, pick up the box in the other room.
